dct_description_sm:
Polygon data representing the extent of municipal water intake protection zones (IPZ-1, IPZ-2, or IPZ-3) within the County of Essex as per the Clean Water Act.

Contains data provided by the Essex Region Conservation Authority (ERCA) for the purpose of inclusion into the County of Essex Official Plan (2014). Please contact the Conservation Authority for the most up to date information.
